research_question: Does the source-backed Abarbanell-Bushee ChInvIA construction recover GKX pchcapx_ia?
formula_rule: Impute missing capx with the change in ppent. Define pchcapx as current capx minus the arithmetic mean of its prior two annual values, divided by that mean; if missing, fall back to the one-year capx growth rate. After mapping to stock-month, subtract the same-month CRSP SIC2 arithmetic mean.
stopping_rule: Evaluate the single source-backed formula once on 1970-1979; later periods are descriptive because predecessor experiments exposed them.
